title: Decision: pool slot re-open attempt at acquire (not just at release) is correct
description: crypto2dev_pool_acquire tries to re-open a failed slot (fd == -1) at acquire time. A contributor might simplify this to 'only re-open at release'. The current approach is correct: release calls open() and on transient failure sets fd = -1. The next acquire then gets a chance to recover, rather than permanently burning the slot for the lifetime of the pool. This provides graceful recovery from transient device unavailability (e.g., device module reload). Without the acquire-side retry, a single failed open during release would permanently drain the pool.
